# Design philosophy

Design guidance and example descriptions. Referenced registrations own the implemented values.

Sources: [SKILL.md](../../skills/design-philosophy/SKILL.md).

## Introduction

Calm, Focused, Consistent, and Delightful are the values behind the system. Use them to explain why a design choice helps the task.

## Principles in practice

Name the feeling, ask the principle’s question, then choose the token or behavior that expresses it.
